from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,requests
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_revision_prior_policy_clock_v1'
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
url=protocol['source_scope']['new_official_statement_url'];p=out/'sources/20240501_FOMC原声明.html'
assert not (out/'new_source_receipt.json').exists()
rec={'url':url,'path':str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),'attempts':[],'tls_verify':True}
for i in range(1,3):
    a={'attempt':i,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()};response=None
    try:
        response=requests.get(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'},timeout=(15,35))
        a['http_status']=response.status_code;response.raise_for_status()
        p.write_bytes(response.content);a['status']='SAVED_ORIGINAL';rec['attempts'].append(a)
        rec.update(status='SAVED_ORIGINAL',bytes=len(response.content),sha256=hashlib.sha256(response.content).hexdigest());break
    except Exception as exc:
        a.update(status='FAILED',error=str(exc)[:700]);rec['attempts'].append(a);rec['status']='SOURCE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED'
        if response is not None and response.status_code in (403,429):break
(out/'new_source_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('E13单一新原页',rec['status'],'尝试',len(rec['attempts']))
if rec['status']!='SAVED_ORIGINAL':raise SystemExit(2)
